metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Cowley's part, a quire, an oath on a gill, six hundred pounds, the Shrew at two, and the Queen at Whitehall.

yesterday: Cowley's part is Benvolio. The cue is corrected.
The hall can be had, come the spring, when the money is found. Allen's ground is still Allen's.
Dick heard the six hundred with you and James. You kept the sum among the three of you.
The Shrew went at two. At the door the news was that the Queen has come up to Whitehall, and nobody could say why. Heminges wants the why sent to Aldermanbury if you have it first.
The quire was fourpence halfpenny, the old trade. That is the only price the day put on paper.
